title: Ohm Brew Blue Slush 50/50 Nic Salt E-Liquid
description: An all-time favourite flavour among vapers, there’s no beating a blue slush when it comes to lip-smacking refreshment. Here it’s realised to ultimate perfection by Ohm Brew, with sweet and tangy Raspberries and Blueberries on the inhale and a subtle, icy menthol exhale. This premium e-liquid’s 50VG/50PG blend hits the sweet spot between flavour and cloud production and the nic salt solution makes it ideal for use in classic e-cigarette starter vape kits and pod vape devices. Perfect for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking the immediate, satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts.
